bank.name: Notable Women in Islam
bank.subject: Islamic Studies
bank.description: The wives, daughters and exemplary women of Islamic history mentioned in the Quran and hadith.

questions.prompt: Who was the first wife of the Holy Prophet (PBUH) and the first person to accept Islam?
questions.explanation: Khadijah bint Khuwaylid (RA) was the Prophet's first wife and the first Muslim.

questions.prompt: Khadijah (RA) supported the Prophet (PBUH) as a successful?
questions.explanation: Khadijah (RA) was a wealthy and respected businesswoman of Makkah.

questions.prompt: Which woman is the only one mentioned by name in the Holy Quran?
questions.explanation: Maryam (Mary), mother of Isa (AS), is named in the Quran.

questions.prompt: Which Surah of the Quran is named after a woman?
questions.explanation: Surah Maryam (19) is named after Maryam (AS).

questions.prompt: Aisha (RA), one of the most learned companions, was the daughter of?
questions.explanation: Aisha bint Abi Bakr (RA) was the daughter of Abu Bakr (RA).

questions.prompt: Which daughter of the Prophet (PBUH) married Ali (RA)?
questions.explanation: Fatimah (RA), the youngest daughter, married Ali (RA).

questions.prompt: Fatimah (RA), daughter of the Prophet (PBUH), is known by which title?
questions.explanation: Fatimah (RA) is called Az-Zahra, 'the radiant one'.

questions.prompt: Which wife of the Prophet (PBUH) was the daughter of Umar (RA) and a hafiza (memoriser of the Quran)?
questions.explanation: Hafsa bint Umar (RA) memorised the Quran; a copy of the compilation was kept with her.

questions.prompt: Asma bint Abi Bakr (RA), who carried food to the Prophet (PBUH) during the Hijrah, is known as?
options: Dhat an-Nitaqayn (the one with two belts)
questions.explanation: Asma (RA) earned the title 'Dhat an-Nitaqayn' for her two belts during the migration.

questions.prompt: Who is regarded as the first martyr of Islam?
questions.explanation: Sumayyah bint Khayyat (RA), a companion, was martyred by the Quraysh.

questions.prompt: Which woman famously defended the Prophet (PBUH) at the Battle of Uhud?
questions.explanation: Nusaybah (RA) fought courageously to protect the Prophet (PBUH) at Uhud.

questions.prompt: Which wife of Pharaoh is praised in the Quran as an example of faith?
questions.explanation: Aasiya, wife of Pharaoh, is cited in the Quran (66:11) as a model believer.

questions.prompt: The Queen of Sheba, who accepted the truth brought by Prophet Sulayman (AS), is known as?
questions.explanation: Bilqis, the Queen of Sheba, submitted to Allah after Sulayman's (AS) message.

questions.prompt: Hajar (RA), the mother of Ismail (AS), is commemorated in Hajj by which rite?
options: The Sa'i between Safa and Marwah
questions.explanation: The Sa'i re-enacts Hajar's (RA) search for water between Safa and Marwah.

questions.prompt: The wives of the Prophet (PBUH) are honoured with which title?
questions.explanation: The Prophet's wives are called the Mothers of the Believers.

questions.prompt: At what age did Khadijah (RA) marry the Prophet (PBUH)?
questions.explanation: Khadijah (RA) was about 40 when she married the Prophet (PBUH), who was 25.

questions.prompt: Which of the Prophet's (PBUH) daughters first married Uthman (RA)?
questions.explanation: Ruqayyah (RA) married Uthman (RA); after her death, Umm Kulthum (RA) married him too.

questions.prompt: The mother of Prophet Musa (AS) is mentioned in the Quran as receiving a divine revelation to?
options: Place Musa in a basket on the river
questions.explanation: Musa's (AS) mother was inspired to put her baby in a basket and let the river carry him.

questions.prompt: Who was the first wife of the Prophet (PBUH) and his greatest supporter?
questions.explanation: Khadijah (RA) was the first to accept Islam and supported the Prophet (PBUH) throughout the early struggle.

questions.prompt: Which daughter of the Prophet (PBUH) married Uthman (RA)?
questions.explanation: Ruqayyah and, after her death, Umm Kulthum married Uthman (RA) — hence his title Dhun-Nurayn.

questions.prompt: What title is given to Fatimah (RA)?
options: Sayyidat-un-Nisa (Leader of the Women of Paradise)
questions.explanation: Fatimah (RA) is titled Sayyidat-un-Nisa, the leader of the women of Paradise.

questions.prompt: Which wife of the Prophet (PBUH) narrated the most hadiths?
questions.explanation: Aisha (RA) narrated over 2,000 hadiths, the most of any woman.

questions.prompt: Who was the first wife of the Prophet (PBUH) after Khadijah's death?
questions.explanation: Sawdah (RA), a widow and early Muslim, married the Prophet (PBUH) after Khadijah.

questions.prompt: Which wife of the Prophet (PBUH) was among the first migrants to Abyssinia and later married him after her husband's death?
questions.explanation: Umm Salama (RA), widow of Abu Salama, was renowned for wisdom and narrated many hadiths.

questions.prompt: Which wife of the Prophet (PBUH) was the daughter of Abu Sufyan, married in Abyssinia?
questions.explanation: Umm Habibah (RA), daughter of Abu Sufyan, married the Prophet (PBUH) while in Abyssinia.

questions.prompt: Which wife of the Prophet (PBUH) was a descendant of the Banu Mustaliq, freed and married after the expedition?
questions.explanation: Juwairiyyah (RA) was freed and married by the Prophet (PBUH), leading her tribe to embrace Islam.

questions.prompt: Who was the first person to embrace Islam after the Prophet's (PBUH) wife Khadijah?
questions.explanation: After Khadijah, Ali (RA), then Zaid (RA), accepted Islam in the first days of the mission.

questions.prompt: Which woman is praised in the Quran as an example of faith for believers alongside Asiya?
questions.explanation: The Quran cites Maryam and Asiya as exemplary women of faith (66:11-12).

questions.prompt: Who was the woman who ran between Safa and Marwah in search of water?
questions.explanation: Hajar (RA), mother of Isma'il (AS), ran between the hills until the Zamzam well appeared.

questions.prompt: Who was the wife of the Egyptian minister (Aziz) who attempted to seduce Yusuf (AS)?
questions.explanation: Zulaikha, wife of the Aziz of Egypt, features in the story of Yusuf (AS) in Surah Yusuf.

questions.prompt: Who was the mother of Prophet Musa (AS)?
options: The wife of Imran, unnamed in the Quran but inspired by Allah
questions.explanation: Musa's (AS) mother, inspired by Allah, placed him in a basket on the river (28:7).

questions.prompt: Who adopted Musa (AS) as a son, raising him in the palace?
questions.explanation: Asiya took the baby Musa (AS) in, and Allah returned him to his mother as nurse.

questions.prompt: Who was the sister of Musa (AS) who followed his basket?
options: His sister, whose name is not given in the Quran
questions.explanation: Musa's (AS) sister followed the basket and suggested his mother as a nurse (28:11-12).

questions.prompt: Which queen is mentioned in the Quran for her wisdom in the story of Sulaiman (AS)?
questions.explanation: The Queen of Sheba (Bilqis) visited Sulaiman (AS) and embraced the truth (27:44).

questions.prompt: Who was the wife of the Prophet (PBUH) from the Banu Nadir who embraced Islam before marriage?
questions.explanation: Safiyyah (RA), daughter of Huyayy ibn Akhtab, embraced Islam and married the Prophet (PBUH).

questions.prompt: Who was the last wife the Prophet (PBUH) married?
questions.explanation: Maimunah (RA) was the last wife married, in 7 AH during the 'Umrat al-Qada'.

questions.prompt: Who was the first woman to embrace Islam?
questions.explanation: Khadijah was the first to accept Islam.

questions.prompt: Which wife of the Prophet (PBUH) was known for narrating many hadith?
questions.explanation: Aisha narrated over two thousand hadith.

questions.prompt: The daughter of the Prophet (PBUH) who married Ali (RA) was:
questions.explanation: Fatimah married Ali ibn Abi Talib.

questions.prompt: Who was the wife of the Prophet (PBUH) known as 'Umm-ul-Masakeen'?
questions.explanation: Zainab bint Khuzaimah was called mother of the poor.

questions.prompt: Which woman is called the 'mother of believers'?
questions.explanation: All the Prophet's (PBUH) wives are Ummahat-ul-Mu'minin.

questions.prompt: The woman who nursed the Prophet (PBUH) as an infant was:
questions.explanation: Halimah Sa'diyah was the Prophet's (PBUH) wet nurse.

questions.prompt: The Prophet's (PBUH) mother was:
questions.explanation: Aminah bint Wahb was the mother of the Prophet (PBUH).

questions.prompt: Which companion woman helped the Muslims at Uhud by treating the wounded?
questions.explanation: Nusaybah defended the Prophet (PBUH) at Uhud.

questions.prompt: Who was the first woman to take part in the 'Bay'ah of Aqabah'?
options: Women were included in the second Aqabah pledge
questions.explanation: Women participated in the second Pledge of Aqabah.

questions.prompt: The famous female scholar and narrator of hadith from the Prophet's (PBUH) family was:
questions.explanation: Aisha was a leading scholar among the companions.

questions.prompt: Who was the daughter of Umar (RA) and wife of the Prophet (PBUH)?
questions.explanation: Hafsa was Umar's daughter and the Prophet's (PBUH) wife.

questions.prompt: The first female Muslim ruler in history was:
questions.explanation: Shajarat al-Durr ruled Egypt in the 13th century.

questions.prompt: The first Muslim woman to migrate to Abyssinia was:
questions.explanation: Umm Salama was among the early migrants.

questions.prompt: Which companion woman was known as the 'nurse of the Muslims'?
questions.explanation: Barakah (Umm Ayman) served the Prophet's (PBUH) household.

questions.prompt: Who was the wife of the Prophet (PBUH) from the Umayyad clan, daughter of Abu Sufyan?
questions.explanation: Umm Habiba was Abu Sufyan's daughter.

questions.prompt: The first woman in Islam to memorise the entire Quran was:
questions.explanation: Hafsa was entrusted with a copy of the Quran.

questions.prompt: The 'Sultan Razia' ruled which Sultanate?
questions.explanation: Razia Sultana ruled Delhi (1236–1240).

questions.prompt: Which wife of the Prophet (PBUH) was married to him after being widowed at Badr?
questions.explanation: Zainab bint Khuzaimah was widowed at Badr.

questions.prompt: The mother of Imam Hasan and Imam Husain was:
questions.explanation: Fatimah was the mother of Hasan and Husain.

questions.prompt: Who was the last wife of the Prophet (PBUH) to pass away?
questions.explanation: Umm Salama was the last of the wives to die.

questions.prompt: The first woman to perform Hijrah to Madinah openly was:
questions.explanation: Umm Kulthum bint Uqbah migrated openly to Madinah.

questions.prompt: Which of the Prophet's (PBUH) daughters passed away during the expedition of Badr?
questions.explanation: Ruqayyah (RA), wife of Uthman (RA), died in 2 AH during the Badr expedition.

questions.prompt: Which daughter of the Prophet (PBUH) passed away about six months after him?
questions.explanation: Fatimah (RA) died about six months after the Prophet (PBUH).

questions.prompt: The Prophet's (PBUH) son Ibrahim was born to which wife?
questions.explanation: Ibrahim (RA) was the son of the Prophet (PBUH) and Maria al-Qibtiyya.

questions.prompt: Zainab bint Jahsh (RA) was married to which companion before the Prophet (PBUH)?
questions.explanation: Zainab bint Jahsh (RA) was first married to Zaid bin Harithah (RA).

questions.prompt: Which wife of the Prophet (PBUH) was his cousin?
questions.explanation: Zainab bint Jahsh (RA) was the Prophet's (PBUH) cousin.

questions.prompt: Which female companion asked the Prophet (PBUH) for a share of the spoils after Khaybar?
questions.explanation: Umm Sinan al-Aslamiyyah (RA) fought at Khaybar and requested a share.

questions.prompt: Rufaydah al-Aslamiyyah is remembered as?
questions.explanation: Rufaydah (RA) set up field hospitals during the Prophet's (PBUH) campaigns.

questions.prompt: The Jewish woman who offered the Prophet (PBUH) poisoned meat at Khaybar was?
questions.explanation: Zainab bint al-Harith poisoned the mutton offered to the Prophet (PBUH).

questions.prompt: Which aunt of the Prophet (PBUH) accepted Islam and was the mother of Zubair (RA)?
questions.explanation: Safiyyah (RA), the Prophet's (PBUH) aunt, was the mother of Zubair (RA).

questions.prompt: The mother of Maryam (AS), wife of Imran, was?
questions.explanation: Hannah, the wife of Imran, dedicated Maryam (AS) to Allah's service.

questions.prompt: Safiyyah (RA), wife of the Prophet (PBUH), was a descendant of which prophet?
questions.explanation: Safiyyah (RA) descended from Harun (AS), hence her name.

questions.prompt: The Battle of the Camel is named after the camel of which of the Prophet's (PBUH) wives?
questions.explanation: The Battle of Jamal (656) is named after Aisha's (RA) camel.

questions.prompt: Asma bint Abi Bakr (RA) was the wife of which companion?
questions.explanation: Asma bint Abi Bakr (RA) married Zubair (RA).

questions.prompt: Which daughter of Abu Bakr (RA) was married to Talha (RA)?
questions.explanation: Umm Kulthum bint Abi Bakr (RA) married Talha (RA).

questions.prompt: Which wife of the Prophet (PBUH) is buried in Makkah rather than Madinah?
questions.explanation: Khadijah (RA) is buried in Jannat al-Mu'alla in Makkah.

questions.prompt: The first wife of the Prophet (PBUH) to pass away was?
questions.explanation: Khadijah (RA) died in the year of sorrow, before the Hijrah.

questions.prompt: Khadijah (RA) passed away in approximately which year?
questions.explanation: Khadijah (RA) died about 620 CE, shortly before the Hijrah.

questions.prompt: Which of Prophet Shuaib's (AS) daughters drew water for Musa (AS) at Madyan?
questions.explanation: One of Shuaib's (AS) daughters brought Musa (AS) water at the well.

questions.prompt: The Prophet (PBUH) had a foster sister from Halima's family named?
questions.explanation: Shayma, Halima's daughter, was the Prophet's (PBUH) foster sister.

questions.prompt: The Prophet's (PBUH) foster brother from Halima's family was?
questions.explanation: Abdullah ibn al-Harith was the Prophet's (PBUH) foster brother.

questions.prompt: Aisha (RA) narrated the incident of the Ifk (slander), which is discussed in which surah?
questions.explanation: Surah An-Nur (24:11-20) addresses the slander against Aisha (RA).

questions.prompt: Which wife of the Prophet (PBUH) was called the 'mother of the poor'?
questions.explanation: Zainab bint Khuzaimah (RA) was known as Umm al-Masakeen for her charity.

questions.prompt: Which of the Prophet's (PBUH) wives accompanied him on the farewell pilgrimage and narrated many rulings?
questions.explanation: Aisha (RA) was with the Prophet (PBUH) at the Farewell Hajj and transmitted many rulings.

questions.prompt: Who was the first woman to accept Islam from the Ansar in Madinah?
questions.explanation: Umm Sulaym (RA) was among the earliest Ansari women to accept Islam.

questions.prompt: Which female companion was the mother of Anas bin Malik (RA)?
questions.explanation: Umm Sulaym (RA), a devoted companion, was the mother of Anas (RA).

questions.prompt: Which woman was called 'Umm Ayman' and served the Prophet (PBUH) as his nurse?
questions.explanation: Barakah (RA), called Umm Ayman, served the Prophet (PBUH) from childhood.

questions.prompt: Which wife of the Prophet (PBUH) was present at the Treaty of Hudaybiyyah and suggested the sacrifice there?
questions.explanation: Umm Salama (RA) advised the Prophet (PBUH) to shave and sacrifice at Hudaybiyyah.

questions.prompt: Which female companion memorised the Quran in the Prophet's (PBUH) lifetime and was a hafiza?
questions.explanation: Hafsa bint Umar (RA) memorised the entire Quran.

questions.prompt: Who was the wife of the Prophet (PBUH) who was the daughter of Abu Sufyan (RA)?
questions.explanation: Umm Habibah (Ramlah) (RA) was the daughter of Abu Sufyan.

questions.prompt: Which wife of the Prophet (PBUH) was from the Banu Mustaliq, freed after the Muraisi expedition?
questions.explanation: Juwairiyyah bint al-Harith (RA) was freed and married after the expedition.

questions.prompt: Which woman was among the first to accept Islam and was the wife of Abu Lahab's son?
questions.explanation: Zainab (RA), the Prophet's (PBUH) daughter, was married to Abu al-As.

questions.prompt: Which daughter of the Prophet (PBUH) was married to Abu al-As ibn al-Rabi'?
questions.explanation: Zainab (RA) married Abu al-As and was reunited with him after Islam.

questions.prompt: Which wife of the Prophet (PBUH) was known for her generosity and was the daughter of Al-Harith?
questions.explanation: Maimunah bint al-Harith (RA), the last wife, was generous and kind.

questions.prompt: Which woman is described in the Quran as the mother of Isa (AS) and a sign for the worlds?
questions.explanation: Maryam (AS), mother of Isa (AS), is a sign for all worlds.

questions.prompt: Which queen is mentioned in the Quran as the ruler of Saba who submitted to Allah?
questions.explanation: Bilqis, the Queen of Sheba, accepted the message of Sulaiman (AS).

questions.prompt: Which wife of Pharaoh is praised in the Quran for her faith?
questions.explanation: Asiya, wife of Pharaoh, is cited as an example for believers.

questions.prompt: Which woman's story involves running between Safa and Marwah?
questions.explanation: Hajar (RA) ran between Safa and Marwah seeking water for Ismail (AS).

questions.prompt: Which female companion was known as the 'mother of the believers' by all Muslims?
questions.explanation: All the wives of the Prophet (PBUH) share the title Ummahat-ul-Momineen.

questions.prompt: Which woman was the first to be martyred in the way of Allah?
questions.explanation: Sumayyah (RA), mother of Ammar (RA), was the first martyr of Islam.

questions.prompt: Which woman defended the Prophet (PBUH) at Uhud with a sword?
questions.explanation: Nusaybah (RA), Umm Ammarah, fought at Uhud to protect the Prophet (PBUH).

questions.prompt: Who was the first woman to rule as a Muslim monarch?
questions.explanation: Razia Sultana of Delhi is generally called the first female Muslim ruler.

questions.prompt: The first female Mamluk ruler of Egypt was?
questions.explanation: Shajar al-Durr ruled Egypt briefly after the death of her husband.

questions.prompt: Which wife of the Prophet (PBUH) migrated openly to Madinah, breaking with custom?
questions.explanation: Umm Kulthum bint Uqbah (RA) made her Hijrah openly.
